mapper.select: SELECT outbound_id FROM wms_short_pick WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND short_pick_id = #{shortPickId}
mapper.sql: SELECT s.short_pick_id, s.outbound_id, s.allocation_id, w.warehouse_id, a.seller_sku, a.location_id, COALESCE(p.location_code, p.barcode) AS location_code, a.batch_no, o.order_id AS receipt_id, o.reference_id AS purchase_order_id, s.short_quantity, k.allow_batch_substitution, s.reason, s.reported_by, s.reported_at, s.replacement_request_id, s.replacement_allocation_id, r.batch_no AS replacement_batch_no, s.replaced_by, s.replaced_at, s.found_quantity, s.missing_quantity, s.counted_by, s.counted_at, s.count_remark, s.confirmed_by, s.confirmed_at FROM wms_short_pick s JOIN wms_outbound_allocation a ON a.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND a.allocation_id = s.allocation_id JOIN wms_outbound_order w ON w.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND w.order_id = s.outbound_id JOIN wms_sales_pick_work k ON k.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND k.outbound_id = s.outbound_id JOIN wms_warehouse_location p ON p.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND p.location_id = a.location_id JOIN wms_inbound_order_line l ON l.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND l.batch_no = a.batch_no JOIN wms_inbound_order o ON o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND o.order_id = l.order_id LEFT JOIN wms_outbound_allocation r ON r.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND r.allocation_id = s.replacement_allocation_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_short_pick(tenant_id, short_pick_id, outbound_id, allocation_id, short_quantity, reason, reported_by, reported_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{id}, #{outboundId}, #{allocationId}, #{quantity}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, #{at})
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_short_pick SET confirmed_by = #{operatorId}, confirmed_at = #{at} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND short_pick_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT quantity - picked_quantity FROM wms_batch_location_balance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo} AND location_id = #{locationId}
